entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide your name or order number? And what specifically is the issue with the item?
The name is Alex Chen. It's about a helmet. There's no 'issue', I just don't want it.

Okay, Alex, I've pulled up your account. I see the Apex safety helmet was delivered 75 days ago. Just to confirm, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference, like the fit or color?
It's the color. The box is still unopened, so it's brand new. I just need to return it.
Understood. Not a problem at all. Since the item was delivered 75 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
Fine. So you're going to send me a label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return, and a prepaid shipping label should be in your email inbox now. Once we receive the helmet, your full refund will be processed. Since you're a VIP member, and for any inconvenience with the product color, I've also added a $15 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase.
Whatever. I guess that's something. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Alex. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
